title: Participate in change management: decision comparison 1
teachingQuestion: What evidence authorizes, validates, rolls back, and learns from this change?
focalInsight: Rows separate decision input from proof of closure.
caption: Compare meaning, decision conditions, and failures. These concise distinctions are paired with the worked examples in the teaching unit.
altSummary: Rows separate decision input from proof of closure.
